paper: SemInv: Detecting Smart Contract Vulnerabilities through Semantic Invariants

research_questions.headline: SemInv detects 125 of 139 labeled contracts with 89.93% recall, 6.58% false-positive rate, and 76.22% F1.
SemInv-ERC reaches 93.42% recall and 89.59% F1 over 152 public ERC violation labels, while structural recovery is evaluated separately.
SemInv reaches at least 95% of its final candidate hits in every paired cohort and reports 89.72% instruction and 91.04% branch coverage at 600 seconds.
Invariant annotations and solver support provide complementary effects; removing both reduces GT-matching hits to 117 of 139 labeled sources.
Among 48 completed PoCs, 45 contain linked SemInv inputs, 39 contain PoC-function matches, and 31 contain function-aligned multi-transaction prefixes.
514 of 735 saved sequences reproduce in all three replays; 513 reproduced explanations match source context.
